exposure: earlier gestation at time of delivery
cohort: 483 primiparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies
finding: The prevalence of significant pelvic floor trauma after vaginal childbirth is higher than generally assumed, with less than half of primiparous women achieving an atraumatic normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that less than half of primiparous women achieved a normal vaginal delivery without significant pelvic floor trauma, highlighting that rates of trauma are higher than generally assumed.
